items.function_short: Blocks the brain's sleepiness signal, so you feel more alert and effort feels easier.
items.function_full: Caffeine is an adenosine receptor antagonist, principally at A1 and A2A receptors. Blocking A1 lifts the inhibitory brake that accumulating adenosine places on arousal circuits, and blocking striatal A2A disinhibits dopaminergic signalling, which produces the alertness and the reduced perception of effort. It is a plant alkaloid and a xenobiotic. No human enzyme, receptor or pathway requires it, and there is no intake below which anything fails. Caffeine withdrawal is not a deficiency state: habitual intake upregulates adenosine receptors, so abrupt cessation unmasks adenosine signalling and produces headache, fatigue and low mood for roughly 2 to 9 days, with headache in about half of regular users. That is physical dependence on a drug, and it resolves completely without resuming the drug.
items.source: PMID 15448977 (Juliano & Griffiths, critical review of caffeine withdrawal, Psychopharmacology 2004); EFSA Scientific Opinion on the safety of caffeine, EFSA Journal 2015;13(5):4102
corrections_applied: No defect flagged by the checker; entry retained unchanged. The checker verified the 50 percent headache incidence and 2 to 9 day duration against Juliano and Griffiths.

items.function_short: A leucine metabolite that slows muscle protein loss during illness, bed rest or ageing.
items.function_full: Beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate is a downstream metabolite of the amino acid leucine. About 5 percent of leucine catabolism proceeds through ketoisocaproate to HMB, so at ordinary protein intakes the body produces only about 0.2 to 0.4 g a day from dietary leucine, and preformed HMB in food (grapefruit, catfish, alfalfa, corn silage) is present in milligram quantities and contributes essentially nothing. The scale is easier to see from the other direction: obtaining a typical 3 g supplemental dose from food would require the 60 g of leucine contained in over 600 g of high quality protein. Its main described action is suppression of muscle proteolysis through the ubiquitin-proteasome pathway, with a weaker effect on mTOR-mediated protein synthesis than leucine itself. Clinical interest sits in muscle-wasting settings such as bed rest, older adults and cancer cachexia. It is a metabolite of an essential amino acid, not an essential nutrient in its own right.
items.source: PMID 23374455 (Wilson et al., International Society of Sports Nutrition position stand: beta-hydroxy-beta-methylbutyrate, J Int Soc Sports Nutr 2013, PMC3568064)
corrections_applied: function_full: the endogenous/dietary inversion fixed. 'an ordinary diet supplies only a few hundred milligrams a day and the body generates the rest internally' replaced with the correct direction, the body produces about 0.2 to 0.4 g a day from dietary leucine and preformed HMB in food is negligible

items.function_short: Quercetin is a plant pigment with no bodily role; taurine supports bile, heart and retina.
items.function_full: These are two unrelated molecules sold together for convenience. Quercetin is a plant flavonol from onions, capers, apples and tea; it is heavily glucuronidated and sulfated on first pass, so free aglycone concentrations in plasma stay in the nanomolar range and most antioxidant actions demonstrated in cell culture cannot occur at achievable oral doses. It has no physiological role in humans and no deficiency state of any kind. Taurine is a sulfur-containing beta-amino acid, the most abundant free amino acid in heart, retina and leukocytes. It conjugates bile acids, stabilises membranes, modulates calcium handling and cell volume, and is required for the mitochondrial tRNA modification that supports respiratory chain protein synthesis. Adults synthesize taurine from cysteine via cysteine sulfinic acid decarboxylase and obtain roughly 40 to 400 mg a day from meat and seafood, so nobody eating ordinary food becomes taurine depleted. Taurine is classified as conditionally essential, and the one documented human depletion is iatrogenic rather than dietary: in children fed long-term on taurine-free parenteral nutrition, plasma taurine ran about 26 plus or minus 13 versus 57 plus or minus 16 micromol/L in controls, and all 8 children tested had abnormal electroretinograms with delayed rod and cone implicit times, detectable before any visual problem was noticed. Taurine depletion also contributes to parenteral-nutrition-associated cholestasis in infants. Adding taurine to the intravenous solution restored plasma taurine in 4 supplemented children and normalised the electroretinogram in 3 of those 4, though plasma taurine relapsed in 2 of those 3 within a year of intravenous taurine being stopped, and the whole evidence base is a small 1985 case series. Paediatric parenteral amino acid solutions now routinely contain taurine, which prevents the problem at source.
items.source: PMID 3917547 (Geggel et al., nutritional requirement for taurine in long-term parenteral nutrition, N Engl J Med 1985); PMID 2122712 (visual function in patients on long-term total parenteral nutrition)

items.function_short: A building block cells use to make NAD+, the coenzyme that keeps energy metabolism running.
items.function_full: Nicotinamide mononucleotide is an intermediate in the NAD+ salvage pathway, formed when nicotinamide phosphoribosyltransferase attaches nicotinamide to phosphoribosyl pyrophosphate, then converted to NAD+ by NMN adenylyltransferases. NAD+ is the electron carrier for hundreds of dehydrogenases and the consumed substrate for sirtuins, PARPs and CD38. NMN is thought to be dephosphorylated to nicotinamide riboside before cellular uptake, though the human intestinal route is not established and the proposed direct NMN transporter is contested: Slc12a8-mediated uptake was reported in mouse small intestine (Grozio et al. 2019) and then disputed on methodological grounds (Shats et al. 2020), and no human transporter has been demonstrated in either direction. NMN itself is not an essential nutrient and has no recommended intake. The essential nutrient in this pathway is niacin (vitamin B3), whose deficiency causes pellagra, a real and severe disease that has nothing to do with NMN intake.
items.source: PMID 29514064 (Rajman, Chwalek & Sinclair, Cell Metab 2018); Grozio et al., Nat Metab 2019;1:47-57; Shats et al., Nat Metab 2020;2:1200-1203; NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Niacin Fact Sheet for Health Professionals (pellagra)
corrections_applied: function_full: 'Oral NMN is largely dephosphorylated to nicotinamide riboside in the gut before absorption in humans' replaced with the correction's own wording, which drops the human claim and states that the intestinal route is not established and the direct transporter is contested
function_full: the Grozio 2019 mouse Slc12a8 report and the Shats 2020 rebuttal named explicitly, since the cited 2018 Sinclair review predates both and cannot support the original claim

items.function_short: A form of vitamin B3 that cells convert into NAD+, the energy metabolism coenzyme.
items.function_full: Nicotinamide riboside is the riboside of nicotinamide, phosphorylated by nicotinamide riboside kinases to NMN and then to NAD+, bypassing the NAMPT step. It occurs naturally in trace amounts in milk. Single oral doses raise whole-blood NAD+ dose-dependently in humans, which is the basis for marketing it as an NAD+ booster; whether raising NAD+ produces clinical benefit in healthy people remains unsettled. NR is a minor chemical form of vitamin B3 rather than a separate essential nutrient. Vitamin B3 deficiency does exist and is called pellagra (dermatitis, diarrhoea, dementia), but it results from lack of dietary niacin and tryptophan and is treated with nicotinamide or nicotinic acid, not with NR.
items.source: PMID 27721479 (Trammell et al., Nat Commun 2016, oral bioavailability of nicotinamide riboside); NIH Office of Dietary Supplements, Niacin Fact Sheet for Health Professionals
corrections_applied: No defect flagged by the checker; entry retained unchanged.

items.function_short: A stress compound made by grapevines. It has no established job in human physiology.
items.function_full: Resveratrol is a stilbene phytoalexin produced by grapevines, Japanese knotweed and peanuts in response to injury and fungal attack. In cell and yeast systems it appears to activate SIRT1, an effect later shown to depend substantially on the fluorophore-tagged assay substrate rather than on the enzyme, and it activates AMPK at high concentrations. In humans absorption is good but bioavailability is very low: it is almost completely converted to sulfate and glucuronide conjugates on first pass, leaving free plasma resveratrol far below the concentrations used in cell experiments. It is a plant secondary metabolite. No human transporter, receptor or enzyme requires it, and nothing in the body fails in its absence.
items.source: PMID 15333514 (Walle et al., high absorption but very low bioavailability of oral resveratrol in humans, Drug Metab Dispos 2004); Linus Pauling Institute Micronutrient Information Center, Resveratrol
corrections_applied: No defect flagged by the checker; entry retained unchanged. The checker specifically endorsed the SIRT1 fluorophore-artifact framing, which is therefore left exactly as written.

items.function_short: A polyamine your own cells make, needed to activate a key protein-building factor.
items.function_full: Spermidine is a polyamine synthesized from putrescine by spermidine synthase using decarboxylated S-adenosylmethionine. Its one indispensable and unique function is donating the aminobutyl group for hypusination of eukaryotic translation initiation factor 5A, a modification required to translate polyproline-containing proteins. It also stabilises nucleic acids and induces autophagy in model organisms, which is the basis of the longevity marketing. Humans get it from three simultaneous sources: de novo synthesis in essentially every cell, gut bacterial production, and food such as wheat germ, aged cheese, soy and mushrooms. Because synthesis is ubiquitous and tightly regulated, dietary intake is never limiting and no deficiency state exists.
items.source: DOI 10.1126/science.aan2788 (Madeo, Eisenberg, Pietrocola & Kroemer, Spermidine in health and disease, Science 2018)
corrections_applied: No defect flagged by the checker; entry retained unchanged.

items.function_short: Carries electrons in the mitochondrial energy chain and protects cell membranes from oxidation.
items.function_full: Coenzyme Q10 is a lipid-soluble benzoquinone with a ten-unit isoprenoid tail. In the inner mitochondrial membrane it shuttles electrons from complexes I and II to complex III, and it is also the electron acceptor for dihydroorotate dehydrogenase in pyrimidine synthesis and for fatty acid beta-oxidation through ETF-QO. Its reduced form, ubiquinol, is the main lipid-phase antioxidant of membranes and regenerates vitamin E. Humans synthesize it through the mevalonate pathway, the same pathway statins inhibit, and food contributes only a few milligrams a day. It is not a vitamin, there is no dietary requirement, and no dietary CoQ10 deficiency state exists. What does exist is primary coenzyme Q10 deficiency (COQ10D1 to COQ10D10), an autosomal recessive inborn error of CoQ10 biosynthesis caused by variants in PDSS1, PDSS2, COQ2, COQ4, COQ5, COQ6, COQ7, COQ8A, COQ8B or COQ9. That is a genetic disorder of synthesis, not a consequence of low dietary intake, and it is ultra-rare: GeneReviews notes that prevalence data are limited by the small number of affected individuals reported, ranging from 2 to just over 10 families per causative gene. Presentation spans the neonatal period to the seventh decade: steroid-resistant nephrotic syndrome with proteinuria, cerebellar ataxia, exercise intolerance and muscle weakness, or encephalopathy with seizures, and diagnosis rests on CoQ10 measurement in muscle or fibroblasts plus genetic testing. Severe neonatal-onset forms cause fatal multisystem disease with encephalopathy, hypertrophic cardiomyopathy and renal failure, while later-onset forms progress to cerebellar atrophy with disabling ataxia or to end-stage kidney disease. High-dose oral CoQ10 can block progression of the kidney disease and improve some myopathic and encephalopathic features, and works best when started before damage is established; established severe neurological or renal damage does not reverse, and neonatal-onset disease responds poorly, partly because CoQ10 penetrates the blood-brain barrier badly. Separately and far more commonly, statins lower circulating CoQ10. Marcoff and Thompson's narrative systematic review of 9 observational studies and 6 randomised trials reports reductions of 16 to 54 percent, with the largest single trial (n=1,049) finding 38 percent with atorvastatin and 27 percent with lovastatin; pooled meta-analysis puts the effect at a weighted mean difference of -0.44 micromol/L (95% CI -0.52 to -0.37). That is a change in a blood concentration, not the disease described above, and trials of CoQ10 for statin-associated muscle symptoms have given conflicting results.
items.source: GeneReviews, Primary Coenzyme Q10 Deficiency Overview, NCBI Bookshelf NBK410087; Marcoff & Thompson, J Am Coll Cardiol 2007;49:2231-2237 (16 to 54 percent statin-associated reduction in circulating CoQ10); Banach et al., Pharmacol Res 2015, PMID 26192349 (meta-analytic WMD -0.44 micromol/L)

items.function_short: A cofactor mitochondria build and clip onto the enzymes that burn carbohydrate and amino acids.
items.function_full: Lipoic acid functions as a covalently bound prosthetic group (lipoamide) on the E2 subunits of pyruvate dehydrogenase, alpha-ketoglutarate dehydrogenase, branched-chain ketoacid dehydrogenase and the glycine cleavage system, where its dithiolane ring carries acyl groups and reducing equivalents. Humans make it de novo inside mitochondria via lipoic acid synthase and attach it enzymatically to apoproteins; free lipoate from food or capsules is never used for this. Rare biallelic LIAS, LIPT1 or LIPT2 variants cause a severe neonatal encephalopathy with lactic acidosis and hyperglycinaemia, and oral lipoic acid does not rescue the lipoylation defect in patients or in patient fibroblasts, which is precisely why that genetic disorder is not a deficiency of the supplement molecule. Supplemental alpha-lipoic acid therefore acts only as a free redox-active compound, unrelated to the cofactor role, and its best evidence is symptomatic relief in diabetic polyneuropathy.
items.source: DOI 10.1007/s10545-014-9705-8 (Mayr et al., Lipoic acid biosynthesis defects, J Inherit Metab Dis 2014); PMID 17065669 (Ziegler et al., SYDNEY 2 trial, Diabetes Care 2006)
corrections_applied: No defect flagged by the checker; entry retained unchanged. This row is the template the checker cited for the creatine and CoQ10 relabels, so it was left untouched on purpose.

items.function_short: A small sulfur molecule sold for joint pain; no body process is known to need it.
items.function_full: Methylsulfonylmethane is dimethyl sulfone, the oxidised metabolite of dimethyl sulfoxide, present in trace amounts in some foods and in the marine sulfur cycle. It is well absorbed and distributes widely, including into cerebrospinal fluid, and a fraction of its sulfur can enter the methionine and cysteine pools. That contribution is trivial next to dietary protein, which supplies all the sulfur amino acid a person needs. Proposed anti-inflammatory effects via NF-kB inhibition come from cell and animal work, and human osteoarthritis trials are small and short. Sulfur as an element is essential; MSM as a molecule is not, and no human enzyme or structure uses it.
items.source: PMID 28300758 (Butawan, Benjamin & Bloomer, Methylsulfonylmethane: applications and safety of a novel dietary supplement, Nutrients 2017, DOI 10.3390/nu9030290)
corrections_applied: No defect flagged by the checker; entry retained unchanged.

items.function_short: A red algal pigment that sits inside cell membranes. Humans have no requirement for it.
items.function_full: Astaxanthin is a xanthophyll carotenoid produced by the microalga Haematococcus pluvialis and concentrated up the food chain into salmon, trout, shrimp and flamingo feathers. Polar keto and hydroxyl groups on both ionone rings let the molecule span the lipid bilayer, which underlies claims that it quenches singlet oxygen and lipid radicals more efficiently than beta-carotene. Unlike beta-carotene it has no provitamin A activity in humans: it is not cleaved to retinal and cannot contribute to vitamin A status. Humans cannot synthesize it and have no need to, since no metabolic process requires it and no intake recommendation exists.
items.source: PMID 7562082 (Jyonouchi H, Sun S, Tomita Y, Gross MD, astaxanthin, a carotenoid without vitamin A activity, augments antibody responses in cultures including T-helper cell clones and suboptimal doses of antigen, J Nutr 1995;125(10):2483-92); EFSA Panel opinion on the safety of astaxanthin, EFSA Journal 2019

items.function_short: The yellow pigment of turmeric. A spice compound, with no role in human physiology.
items.function_full: Curcumin is a diarylheptanoid pigment making up roughly 2 to 5 percent of turmeric rhizome. It binds and weakly inhibits a very large number of unrelated proteins in vitro, which is why it appears in thousands of papers; medicinal chemists classify it as a pan-assay interference compound, since its chemical reactivity, aggregation and fluorescence generate false positives across screening assays. Unformulated curcumin is poorly absorbed, rapidly glucuronidated and sulfated, and essentially undetectable as the free compound in plasma even after gram doses, though piperine, phospholipid and nanoparticle formulations raise exposure. It is a plant secondary metabolite with no physiological role in humans and no requirement.
items.source: PMID 28074653 (Nelson et al., The Essential Medicinal Chemistry of Curcumin, J Med Chem 2017)
corrections_applied: No defect flagged by the checker; entry retained unchanged. The PAINS characterisation was explicitly endorsed and is left as written.

items.function_short: A tea polyphenol the body does not need; concentrated extracts can injure the liver.
items.function_full: Epigallocatechin-3-gallate is the dominant catechin of green tea. It is poorly absorbed, extensively methylated, glucuronidated and sulfated, and degraded by gut microbiota, leaving free plasma EGCG in the sub-micromolar range. Proposed actions include inhibition of catechol-O-methyltransferase, modest effects on fat oxidation and binding to the 67 kDa laminin receptor, none of which establish any physiological requirement. The important safety fact runs the other way: concentrated extracts, especially taken while fasting, cause idiosyncratic hepatocellular injury, with published cases spanning intakes of roughly 140 to 1000 mg EGCG per day and a strong association with the HLA-B*35:01 allele. Brewed tea as a beverage is not implicated at these concentrations.
items.source: Oketch-Rabah et al., United States Pharmacopeia comprehensive review of the hepatotoxicity of green tea extracts, Toxicol Rep 2020;7:386-402; NIH LiverTox, Green Tea, NCBI Bookshelf NBK547925
corrections_applied: No defect flagged by the checker; entry retained unchanged. The checker verified the USP 140 to ~1000 mg EGCG range and the fasting-bioavailability mechanism against the source.

Checked against the rule that reversibility must describe recovery from deficiency and never from toxicity: the hepatotoxicity statement already sits in function_full and reversibility already reads NA, so no field needed moving.

items.function_short: Cartilage building blocks your own cells make from glucose, so eating them is not required.
items.function_full: Glucosamine is an amino sugar produced in every cell from fructose-6-phosphate by glutamine-fructose-6-phosphate amidotransferase, the entry step of the hexosamine biosynthetic pathway that supplies UDP-N-acetylglucosamine for glycosaminoglycans, proteoglycans and O-GlcNAc signalling. Chondroitin sulfate is a sulfated glycosaminoglycan chain assembled on proteoglycan core proteins in the Golgi. Both are made on demand from glucose and glutamine, so neither is a required dietary component and neither has a recommended intake. Orally administered chondroitin is a large polysaccharide with low and variable absorption, and oral glucosamine does not raise synovial fluid concentrations anywhere near those used in cartilage cell experiments. The real question is efficacy rather than nutritional need: the NIH GAIT trial found no significant benefit over placebo for knee osteoarthritis pain in the overall study population.
items.source: PMID 16495392 (Clegg et al., Glucosamine, chondroitin sulfate, and the two in combination for painful knee osteoarthritis, N Engl J Med 2006)
corrections_applied: No defect flagged by the checker; entry retained unchanged. The checker judged the GAIT characterisation correctly hedged to the overall study population rather than the moderate-to-severe subgroup, so that wording was deliberately not touched.

items.function_short: Not a nutrient. This is the practice of taking antioxidant pills while on chemotherapy.
items.function_full: This entry is a clinical scenario rather than a substance, and there is no antioxidant deficiency to correct. Anthracyclines, platinum agents, alkylating agents and radiotherapy kill tumour cells partly through reactive oxygen species and oxidative DNA damage, so high-dose antioxidants taken concurrently could in principle shield the tumour along with normal tissue, and tumour cells themselves often depend on antioxidant defences to survive. In the largest prospective dataset, 1,134 women in the SWOG S0221 adjuvant breast cancer trial, self-reported use of any antioxidant supplement (vitamin A, C or E, carotenoids or coenzyme Q10) both before and during chemotherapy was associated with a borderline increase in recurrence (adjusted hazard ratio 1.41, 95% CI 0.98 to 2.04, P = .06) and in death (adjusted hazard ratio 1.40, 95% CI 0.90 to 2.18, P = .14), with separately significant signals for vitamin B12 and for iron. These associations are observational within a randomised trial cohort and both antioxidant confidence intervals cross 1, so this is a well-founded caution rather than proof of harm, and it underpins oncology advice to avoid supplements other than a standard multivitamin during treatment unless a specific deficiency has been diagnosed.
items.source: PMID 31855498, DOI 10.1200/JCO.19.01203 (Ambrosone et al., Dietary Supplement Use During Chemotherapy and Survival Outcomes, SWOG S0221, J Clin Oncol 2020;38:804-814)
corrections_applied: deficiency_state NA to NONE under the NA-versus-NONE rule. The question was evaluated and the answer is that no deficiency state exists (the entry says so outright, 'there is no antioxidant deficiency to correct'). NA is reserved for a compound product whose constituent nutrients each have their own entry elsewhere, and this row is a clinical practice, not such a product

the borderline SWOG S0221 result left exactly as written, probabilistic and confidence-interval-bearing, neither softened nor hardened. The checker verified n=1,134, HR 1.41 (0.98-2.04, P=.06) and HR 1.40 (0.90-2.18) against the source

items.function_short_zh: 在肌肉和脑细胞内循环再生ATP,在短时间高强度用力时缓冲能量供应。
items.function_full_zh: 肌酸经肌酸激酶磷酸化生成磷酸肌酸,这是一个周转迅速的磷酸储库,在高强度收缩期间及神经元中由ADP再生ATP。每日周转量中约一半(约1至3 g)由AGAT和GAMT在肝、肾和胰腺中以精氨酸、甘氨酸和蛋氨酸为原料内源合成;其余来自肉类和鱼类。没有膳食摄入需求。素食者肌内肌酸含量比杂食者低约10%至15%,但仍然健康,只是对补充的反应更强。这一范围来自两种不同的研究设计:Blancquaert等2018年的研究是在40名杂食女性中进行的干预试验,其中素食加安慰剂组的股外侧肌总肌酸在3个月内下降15%(相比之下,素食加肌酸组升高9.7%,杂食对照组升高6.8%);而对习惯性素食者的横断面比较报告的差距较小,约为10%。与摄入量无关的是,三种先天性代谢缺陷会导致脑肌酸缺乏综合征:GAMT缺乏症、AGAT缺乏症和X连锁肌酸转运体(SLC6A8)缺乏症。这些是合成或转运的基因缺陷,并非肌酸摄入不足的后果,任何膳食模式都不会导致它们。起病于婴儿期或幼儿早期,表现为全面发育迟缓、与其他能力不成比例的表达性言语迟缓和肌张力低下,GAMT缺乏症还伴有早发性癫痫和运动障碍;脑磁共振波谱显示肌酸峰缺失或接近缺失是诊断依据。未经治疗的GAMT缺乏症会导致顽固性癫痫发作、孤独症样特征、锥体外系运动障碍和重度智力障碍,胍基乙酸的蓄积也促成了神经毒性;肌酸转运体缺乏症则导致患病男性终身中至重度智力障碍和癫痫发作。AGAT和GAMT缺乏症对口服肌酸有反应(GAMT缺乏症需同时限制精氨酸并补充鸟氨酸),6月龄前接受治疗的8名婴儿中有7名发育结局正常,这正是早期检测具有决定性意义的原因;肌酸转运体缺乏症则对口服肌酸完全无反应,因为将肌酸转运入脑的转运蛋白本身就是受损蛋白。在发病率方面,GeneReviews给出的GAMT估计发病率为1:2,640,000至1:250,000;犹他州和纽约州的前瞻性新生儿筛查发现发病率为1:405,655;一项2001至2011年间收治5名患者的单中心转诊病例系列得出了高得多的离群估计值1:114,000。肌酸转运体缺乏症在智力障碍男性队列中的报告比例为0.4%至1.4%,而在另一项更近期、既不限于男性也不限于病因不明智力障碍的神经发育障碍个体队列中,比例为2.64%。

items.function_short_zh: 作为合成肌肽的原料,肌肽能缓冲高强度运动中肌肉内的酸性物质堆积。
items.function_full_zh: β-丙氨酸是肌肽合成酶的限速底物,该酶将其与组氨酸结合,在骨骼肌中生成肌肽。肌肽在生理pH范围内作为细胞内酸碱缓冲剂,同时还能螯合金属并清除活性羰基。补充可使肌肉肌肽在4周时提高多达64%,在10周时提高多达80%,并在约0.5至10分钟的运动中带来小幅的成绩提升,30秒以下无效,超过10分钟则仅有不显著的中等效应(Saunders等2017年,40项研究,1,461名受试者);ISSN立场声明将最明显的效益归于持续1至4分钟的开放式终点任务和计时赛。人体经肝脏中尿嘧啶降解生成β-丙氨酸,也从肉类中的肌肽和鹅肌肽获取。它是一种非必需氨基酸,没有推荐摄入量。

items.function_short_zh: 阻断大脑的困倦信号,使人更清醒,并让用力的感觉变得更轻松。
items.function_full_zh: 咖啡因是一种腺苷受体拮抗剂,主要作用于A1和A2A受体。阻断A1受体可解除堆积的腺苷对唤醒回路施加的抑制性刹车,而阻断纹状体A2A受体可解除对多巴胺能信号的抑制,由此产生清醒感并降低对用力程度的主观感受。它是一种植物生物碱,也是一种外源化学物。没有任何人体酶、受体或通路需要它,也不存在低于某摄入量就会出现功能失常的情况。咖啡因戒断并非缺乏状态:长期摄入会上调腺苷受体,因此突然停用会使腺苷信号失去掩盖,产生头痛、疲劳和情绪低落,持续约2至9天,约半数常规饮用者会出现头痛。这属于对一种药物的生理依赖,一旦发生便会完全消退,无需恢复用药。

items.function_short_zh: 亮氨酸的一种代谢产物,可减缓疾病、卧床或衰老期间肌肉蛋白的流失。
items.function_full_zh: β-羟基-β-甲基丁酸是氨基酸亮氨酸的下游代谢产物。亮氨酸分解代谢中约5%经α-酮异己酸途径生成HMB,因此在通常的蛋白质摄入水平下,人体每天仅由膳食亮氨酸生成约0.2至0.4 g HMB,而食物(西柚、鲶鱼、苜蓿、青贮玉米)中天然存在的HMB仅为毫克级,贡献基本可以忽略。从另一个角度更容易看出其量级:要从食物中获得典型的3 g补充剂量,需要摄入600多克优质蛋白质中所含的60 g亮氨酸。其已知的主要作用是通过泛素蛋白酶体途径抑制肌肉蛋白水解,对mTOR介导的蛋白质合成的促进作用则弱于亮氨酸本身。临床关注点在于肌肉消耗相关情境,如卧床、老年人和癌症恶病质。它是一种必需氨基酸的代谢产物,本身并非必需营养素。

items.function_short_zh: 槲皮素是一种在人体内无生理作用的植物色素;牛磺酸支持胆汁、心脏和视网膜功能。
items.function_full_zh: 这是两种为方便合并销售的不相关分子。槲皮素是一种来自洋葱、刺山柑、苹果和茶的植物黄酮醇;它在首过代谢中被大量葡萄糖醛酸化和硫酸化,因此血浆中游离苷元浓度维持在纳摩尔范围,细胞培养中展示的大多数抗氧化作用在可达到的口服剂量下都无法实现。它在人体内没有生理作用,也不存在任何形式的缺乏状态。牛磺酸是一种含硫β-氨基酸,是心脏、视网膜和白细胞中含量最高的游离氨基酸。它结合胆汁酸、稳定细胞膜、调节钙处理和细胞体积,并且是支持呼吸链蛋白合成的线粒体tRNA修饰所必需的。成人通过半胱氨酸亚磺酸脱羧酶由半胱氨酸合成牛磺酸,并从肉类和海鲜中获得每日约40至400 mg,因此正常饮食的人不会出现牛磺酸缺乏。牛磺酸被归类为条件必需营养素,而目前唯一有记录的人体缺乏是医源性而非饮食性的:在长期接受不含牛磺酸的肠外营养的儿童中,血浆牛磺酸约为26加减13,而对照组为57加减16微摩尔/升,受检测的8名儿童全部出现视网膜电图异常,表现为视杆和视锥内隐含时延长,且在出现任何视觉问题之前即可检出。牛磺酸缺乏还与婴儿肠外营养相关性胆汁淤积有关。在静脉输液中添加牛磺酸使4名接受补充的儿童血浆牛磺酸恢复正常,其中3名的视网膜电图恢复正常,不过这3名中有2名在停用静脉牛磺酸后一年内血浆牛磺酸出现反弹,而且整个证据基础仅来自1985年的一项小型病例系列。目前儿科肠外氨基酸溶液已常规含有牛磺酸,从源头上预防了这一问题。

items.function_short_zh: 细胞用来合成NAD+的原料之一,NAD+是维持能量代谢运转的辅酶。
items.function_full_zh: 烟酰胺单核苷酸是NAD+补救合成途径中的中间产物,由烟酰胺磷酸核糖转移酶将烟酰胺连接到磷酸核糖焦磷酸上生成,随后经NMN腺苷酰转移酶转化为NAD+。NAD+是数百种脱氢酶的电子载体,也是sirtuin、PARP和CD38消耗的底物。目前认为NMN在被细胞摄取之前会先脱磷酸化为烟酰胺核糖,不过人体肠道内的具体途径尚未确立,而所提出的直接NMN转运体也存在争议:Slc12a8介导的摄取曾在小鼠小肠中被报道(Grozio等2019年),随后又因方法学问题受到质疑(Shats等2020年),目前尚无论证表明人体存在这种方向上的转运体。NMN本身并非必需营养素,也没有推荐摄入量。这一通路中真正的必需营养素是烟酸(维生素B3),其缺乏会导致糙皮病,这是一种真实存在的严重疾病,与NMN摄入与否无关。

items.function_short_zh: 维生素B3的一种形式,细胞将其转化为NAD+,即能量代谢辅酶。
items.function_full_zh: 烟酰胺核糖是烟酰胺的核糖苷,经烟酰胺核糖激酶磷酸化为NMN,再进一步转化为NAD+,绕过了NAMPT这一步骤。它天然微量存在于牛奶中。单次口服可剂量依赖性地升高人体全血NAD+水平,这是将其作为NAD+助推剂进行营销的依据;但升高NAD+是否能给健康人带来临床获益仍未确定。NR是维生素B3的一种次要化学形式,而非独立的必需营养素。维生素B3缺乏确实存在,称为糙皮病(皮炎、腹泻、痴呆),但其成因是膳食烟酸和色氨酸摄入不足,治疗用烟酰胺或烟酸,而非NR。

items.function_short_zh: 一种由葡萄藤在受胁迫时产生的化合物,在人体生理中没有已确立的作用。
items.function_full_zh: 白藜芦醇是一种茋类植物抗毒素,由葡萄藤、虎杖和花生在受到损伤或真菌侵袭时产生。在细胞和酵母系统中,它似乎能激活SIRT1,但后续研究表明这一效应在很大程度上取决于所用荧光标记检测底物,而非对该酶的真实作用;在高浓度下它还能激活AMPK。在人体内它吸收良好,但生物利用度很低:首过代谢中几乎完全被转化为硫酸盐和葡萄糖醛酸盐结合物,使血浆中游离白藜芦醇浓度远低于细胞实验所用的浓度。它是一种植物次生代谢物。没有任何人体转运体、受体或酶需要它,缺乏它也不会导致人体任何功能失常。

items.function_short_zh: 一种由自身细胞合成的多胺,是激活某个关键蛋白质合成因子所必需的。
items.function_full_zh: 亚精胺是一种多胺,由腐胺经亚精胺合酶利用脱羧S-腺苷甲硫氨酸合成而来。它唯一不可替代且独特的功能是为真核翻译起始因子5A的亚精胺化(hypusination)提供氨丁基基团,这一修饰是翻译含多聚脯氨酸蛋白质所必需的。它还能稳定核酸,并在模式生物中诱导自噬,这正是其长寿营销概念的依据。人体同时从三个来源获得亚精胺:几乎所有细胞的从头合成、肠道细菌的产生,以及小麦胚芽、熟成奶酪、大豆和蘑菇等食物。由于合成过程普遍存在且受到严格调控,膳食摄入从不构成限制因素,也不存在任何缺乏状态。

items.function_short_zh: 在线粒体能量链中传递电子,并保护细胞膜免受氧化损伤。
items.function_full_zh: 辅酶Q10是一种脂溶性苯醌,带有由十个异戊二烯单位组成的侧链。在线粒体内膜中,它将电子从复合体I和复合体II传递到复合体III,同时也是嘧啶合成中二氢乳清酸脱氢酶以及经ETF-QO途径进行脂肪酸β氧化时的电子受体。其还原型泛醇是细胞膜上主要的脂相抗氧化物质,并能再生维生素E。人体通过甲羟戊酸途径合成辅酶Q10,他汀类药物抑制的正是这一途径,食物每天仅贡献几毫克。它不是维生素,没有膳食摄入需求,也不存在膳食性辅酶Q10缺乏状态。真正存在的是原发性辅酶Q10缺乏症(COQ10D1至COQ10D10),这是一种由PDSS1、PDSS2、COQ2、COQ4、COQ5、COQ6、COQ7、COQ8A、COQ8B或COQ9基因变异引起的、辅酶Q10生物合成缺陷的常染色体隐性遗传病。这是一种合成通路的基因病,而非膳食摄入不足的后果,且极为罕见:GeneReviews指出,由于报告的患者数量很少,患病率数据有限,每个致病基因对应的家系报告数在2至略超10个之间。发病可见于新生儿期至70岁,表现为伴蛋白尿的激素抵抗型肾病综合征、小脑共济失调、运动不耐受和肌无力,或伴癫痫发作的脑病,诊断依赖肌肉或成纤维细胞中辅酶Q10测定加基因检测。重度新生儿起病型可导致致死性多系统疾病,伴脑病、肥厚型心肌病和肾衰竭,而较晚起病型则进展为小脑萎缩伴致残性共济失调,或进展为终末期肾病。大剂量口服辅酶Q10可阻止肾脏疾病进展,并改善部分肌病和脑病表现,在损伤尚未确立前开始治疗效果最佳;而一旦出现严重的神经系统或肾脏损伤则无法逆转,新生儿起病型的反应也较差,部分原因是辅酶Q10难以穿透血脑屏障。与此完全不同、也更为常见的是,他汀类药物会降低循环辅酶Q10水平。Marcoff和Thompson对9项观察性研究和6项随机试验的叙述性系统综述报告降幅为16%至54%,其中单项最大规模试验(n=1,049)发现阿托伐他汀降幅为38%,洛伐他汀为27%;汇总meta分析得出的加权均数差为-0.44微摩尔/升(95%置信区间-0.52至-0.37)。这是一种血液浓度的变化,而非上文所述的疾病,且辅酶Q10用于治疗他汀相关肌肉症状的试验结果并不一致。

items.function_short_zh: 线粒体自行合成并连接到多种分解碳水化合物和氨基酸的酶上的辅因子。
items.function_full_zh: 硫辛酸作为共价结合的辅基(硫辛酰胺)存在于丙酮酸脱氢酶、α-酮戊二酸脱氢酶、支链酮酸脱氢酶和甘氨酸裂解系统的E2亚基上,其二硫戊环结构负责传递酰基和还原当量。人体通过硫辛酸合成酶在线粒体内从头合成硫辛酸,并以酶促方式将其连接到脱辅基蛋白上;来自食物或胶囊的游离硫辛酸盐从不用于这一过程。罕见的LIAS、LIPT1或LIPT2双等位基因变异会导致伴乳酸酸中毒和高甘氨酸血症的严重新生儿脑病,口服硫辛酸无法在患者体内或患者成纤维细胞中挽救这一硫辛酰化缺陷,这正是该遗传病并非补充剂分子缺乏症的原因所在。因此,补充用α-硫辛酸只能作为一种游离的氧化还原活性化合物发挥作用,与其辅因子角色无关,其最佳证据体现在缓解糖尿病性多发性神经病变的症状方面。

items.function_short_zh: 一种用于关节疼痛的小分子含硫化合物;目前未知有任何身体过程需要它。
items.function_full_zh: 甲基磺酰基甲烷即二甲基砜,是二甲亚砜的氧化代谢产物,微量存在于部分食物和海洋硫循环中。它吸收良好,可广泛分布,包括进入脑脊液,其中一部分硫可进入蛋氨酸和半胱氨酸池。相较于提供人体所需全部含硫氨基酸的膳食蛋白质而言,这一贡献微不足道。所提出的通过NF-kB抑制发挥抗炎作用的证据来自细胞和动物实验,人体骨关节炎试验规模小且时间短。硫作为一种元素是必需的;MSM作为一种分子则不是,没有任何人体酶或结构需要它。

items.function_short_zh: 一种存在于细胞膜内的红色藻类色素。人体对它没有摄入需求。
items.function_full_zh: 虾青素是由雨生红球藻产生的一种叶黄素类类胡萝卜素,经食物链富集进入鲑鱼、鳟鱼、虾以及火烈鸟羽毛。其两个紫罗兰酮环上的极性酮基和羟基使该分子能够横跨脂质双分子层,这也是它被认为比β-胡萝卜素更有效地淬灭单线态氧和脂质自由基的依据。与β-胡萝卜素不同,它在人体内没有维生素A原活性:它不会被裂解为视黄醛,也不能对维生素A状态有所贡献。人体无法合成它,也没有合成它的需要,因为没有任何代谢过程需要它,也不存在摄入推荐量。

items.supplement_zh: 姜黄素 / 姜黄提取物
items.function_short_zh: 姜黄的黄色色素成分。一种香料化合物,在人体生理中没有作用。
items.function_full_zh: 姜黄素是一种二芳基庚烷类色素,约占姜黄根茎的2%至5%。它在体外能与大量互不相关的蛋白质结合并弱抑制其活性,这也是它在数千篇论文中出现的原因;药物化学家将其归类为泛测定干扰化合物(PAINS),因为其化学反应活性、聚集性和荧光特性会在各类筛选测定中产生假阳性。未经处理的姜黄素吸收很差,会被迅速葡萄糖醛酸化和硫酸化,即使服用克级剂量,血浆中游离化合物也基本检测不到,不过胡椒碱、磷脂或纳米颗粒制剂可提高其暴露量。它是一种植物次生代谢物,在人体内没有生理作用,也没有摄入需求。

items.function_short_zh: 一种人体并不需要的茶多酚;高浓度提取物可能损伤肝脏。
items.function_full_zh: 表没食子儿茶素没食子酸酯(EGCG)是绿茶中含量最高的儿茶素。它吸收较差,会被大量甲基化、葡萄糖醛酸化和硫酸化,并被肠道菌群降解,使血浆中游离EGCG浓度维持在亚微摩尔范围。所提出的作用包括抑制儿茶酚-O-甲基转移酶、对脂肪氧化的轻微影响,以及与67 kDa层粘连蛋白受体的结合,但这些都不能确立任何生理需求。真正重要的安全事实方向恰恰相反:高浓度提取物,尤其是在空腹状态下服用时,可引起特异质性肝细胞损伤,已发表病例涉及的EGCG摄入量约为每天140至1000 mg,并与HLA-B*35:01等位基因存在密切关联。作为饮品的冲泡茶在这些浓度下不涉及该风险。

items.supplement_zh: 氨基葡萄糖与硫酸软骨素
items.function_short_zh: 软骨的组成原料,人体细胞自行由葡萄糖合成,因此并非必须通过饮食摄入。
items.function_full_zh: 氨基葡萄糖是一种氨基糖,由每个细胞内的谷氨酰胺果糖-6-磷酸酰胺转移酶从果糖-6-磷酸生成,这是己糖胺生物合成途径的起始步骤,该途径为糖胺聚糖、蛋白聚糖和O-GlcNAc信号传导提供UDP-N-乙酰氨基葡萄糖。硫酸软骨素是在高尔基体中于蛋白聚糖核心蛋白上组装而成的一种硫酸化糖胺聚糖链。两者均按需由葡萄糖和谷氨酰胺合成,因此都不是必需的膳食成分,也没有推荐摄入量。口服的硫酸软骨素是一种大分子多糖,吸收率低且变异大;口服氨基葡萄糖也无法使滑液浓度达到接近软骨细胞实验所用浓度的水平。真正的问题在于疗效而非营养需求:NIH的GAIT试验发现,在整体研究人群中,对膝骨关节炎疼痛并无显著优于安慰剂的效果。

items.supplement_zh: 化疗期间使用抗氧化剂
items.function_short_zh: 并非一种营养素。指在接受化疗期间服用抗氧化剂药片这一做法。
items.function_full_zh: 这一条目描述的是一种临床情境而非某种物质,也不存在需要纠正的抗氧化剂缺乏。蒽环类药物、铂类药物、烷化剂和放疗部分是通过活性氧和氧化性DNA损伤来杀伤肿瘤细胞的,因此同时服用大剂量抗氧化剂理论上可能会在保护正常组织的同时也保护肿瘤,而肿瘤细胞自身也往往依赖抗氧化防御来维持存活。在规模最大的前瞻性数据集中,SWOG S0221辅助乳腺癌试验纳入的1,134名女性中,自我报告在化疗前及化疗期间使用任何抗氧化剂补充剂(维生素A、C或E、类胡萝卜素或辅酶Q10)与复发风险的临界性升高相关(校正后风险比1.41,95%置信区间0.98至2.04,P=.06)以及死亡风险的临界性升高相关(校正后风险比1.40,95%置信区间0.90至2.18,P=.14),同时还观察到维生素B12和铁分别存在独立显著的信号。这些关联是在一项随机试验队列内部进行的观察性分析,且两个抗氧化剂相关的置信区间都跨过1,因此这属于有充分依据的审慎提示,而非已证实的危害,它也是肿瘤学建议在治疗期间避免使用标准复合维生素以外的补充剂(除非已确诊某种特定缺乏)的依据之一。

items.function_short: A hormone the pineal gland releases after dark to tell the body clock that night has begun.
items.function_full: Melatonin is synthesised from serotonin in the pineal gland on a schedule set by the suprachiasmatic nucleus, rising roughly two hours before habitual sleep onset and clearing by morning. It acts through MT1 and MT2 receptors on the clock itself, so it works as a timing signal rather than a sedative, which is why small evening doses shift sleep phase more reliably than large doses deepen sleep. There is no dietary requirement at all: the body makes every molecule it uses. Nocturnal peak concentrations do fall with age (pooled maxima around 49 pg/mL in study populations averaging 65 to 70 years and around 28 pg/mL in those 75 and over), and ordinary evening room light below 200 lux delays melatonin onset in 99% of people and shortens the nocturnal melatonin window by about 90 minutes, so the common problem is a mistimed or blunted signal rather than an absent nutrient.
items.source: PMID 27302542 (Scholtens et al., J Psychosom Res 2016;86:20-27, physiological melatonin levels in healthy older people); PMID 21193540 (Gooley et al., J Clin Endocrinol Metab 2011;96:E463-72, evening room light suppresses melatonin onset)

items.function_short: A plant alkaloid that lowers blood sugar and cholesterol; the body has no need for it.
items.function_full: Berberine is an isoquinoline alkaloid extracted from Berberis, Coptis and Hydrastis species. Its metabolic effects are usually attributed to activation of AMP-activated protein kinase, and the upstream trigger appears to be mild inhibition of mitochondrial complex I that raises the cellular AMP to ATP ratio (Turner et al., Diabetes 2008;57:1414-1418), giving it a mechanistic family resemblance to metformin. AMPK is not the whole account: Xu et al. confirmed the complex I effect but concluded that berberine promotes glucose consumption independently of AMPK activation. Downstream it suppresses hepatic gluconeogenesis, and it upregulates hepatic LDL receptor expression through ERK-dependent stabilisation of LDL receptor mRNA rather than through AMPK (Kong et al., Nat Med 2004;10:1344-1351). Oral absorption is very poor, with absolute bioavailability under 1% in rats, so a substantial share of any effect is probably exerted in the gut lumen and on the microbiota. It is a xenobiotic: no human tissue synthesises it and no physiological process depends on its presence.
items.source: DOI 10.1371/journal.pone.0103702 (Xu M, Xiao Y, Yin J, Hou W, Yu X, Shen L, Liu F, Wei L, Jia W, PLoS One 2014;9:e103702, berberine promotes glucose consumption independently of AMPK activation); Turner et al., Diabetes 2008;57:1414-1418 (berberine inhibits mitochondrial complex I and raises the cellular AMP:ATP ratio); Kong et al., Nat Med 2004;10:1344-1351 (berberine upregulates the hepatic LDL receptor by ERK-dependent mRNA stabilisation); DOI 10.1016/j.apsb.2012.06.003 (Yin, Ye & Jia, Acta Pharm Sin B 2012;2:327-334, effects and mechanisms of berberine in diabetes, oral bioavailability under 1%)
corrections_applied: source: PLoS One 2014;9:e103702 re-attributed from 'Yin et al.' to its actual authorship, Xu M, Xiao Y, Yin J, Hou W, Yu X, Shen L, Liu F, Wei L, Jia W
function_full: added that the paper's headline conclusion is AMPK-independent glucose consumption, so the AMPK sentence no longer rests on a paper that argues against it

function_full/source: the AMP:ATP claim now cites Turner et al., Diabetes 2008;57:1414-1418, and hepatic LDL-receptor upregulation now cites Kong et al., Nat Med 2004;10:1344-1351, and is described as ERK-dependent mRNA stabilisation rather than an AMPK effect
source: Acta Pharm Sin B 2012 given its authors (Yin, Ye & Jia) and pages 327-334

items.function_short: A root extract taken for stress; it plays no part in normal human physiology.
items.function_full: Withania somnifera root contains withanolides (principally withaferin A and withanolide A) together with sitoindosides, and commercial extracts are standardised to withanolide content. Randomised trials running 8 to 12 weeks report modest reductions in self-rated stress scales and in morning serum cortisol, while the proposed HPA axis and GABA-A receptor mechanisms rest largely on animal and in vitro work. Nothing in the human body synthesises withanolides and no metabolic pathway requires them, so this is a pharmacological exposure rather than a nutritional one. Liver injury is a documented harm: a case series from Iceland and the US Drug-Induced Liver Injury Network described five patients (3 male, 2 female, mean age 43, range 21 to 62) who became jaundiced 2 to 12 weeks after starting ashwagandha, with cholestatic or mixed injury (R ratios 1.4 to 3.3) and hyperbilirubinaemia persisting 5 to 20 weeks. Liver tests normalised within 1 to 5 months in four of the five and the fifth was lost to follow-up; no patient developed hepatic failure and there were no deaths or transplants in the series.
items.source: PMID 31991029 (Bjornsson et al., Liver Int 2020;40:825-829, ashwagandha-induced liver injury case series); LiverTox monograph NBK548536
corrections_applied: function_full: separated the two intervals the original merged, hyperbilirubinaemia persisting 5 to 20 weeks and liver tests normalising within 1 to 5 months, and stated that normalisation was documented in four patients with the fifth lost to follow-up rather than implying all five recovered
function_full: added the series demographics (3 male, 2 female, mean age 43, range 21 to 62) and the R ratios 1.4 to 3.3
function_full: added the paper's own conclusion that no patient developed hepatic failure and there were no deaths or transplants

items.function_short: An Arctic root extract sold for fatigue; the body neither makes nor requires it.
items.function_full: Rhodiola rosea rhizome supplies the rosavins (rosavin, rosin, rosarin) and salidroside, and the best studied preparation, SHR-5, is standardised to roughly 3% rosavins and 1% salidroside. Proposed actions include weak monoamine oxidase inhibition and blunting of stress-induced cortisol responses, neither well characterised in humans. A 2021 systematic review of 39 randomised trials spanning four Rhodiola species (23 of R. rosea, 8 of R. crenulata, 8 of R. wallichiana and 1 of R. sacra, the last excluded from quality assessment) found that no study met all CONSORT criteria, so reporting quality is too poor to support firm efficacy conclusions and trials of different species are routinely conflated. An earlier review restricted to 11 placebo-controlled trials of R. rosea alone judged methodological quality moderate or good (5 of 10 scored above 3 on Jadad) and concluded the species may benefit physical performance, mental performance and certain mental-health conditions, its stated limitation being the absence of independent replication. These are plant secondary metabolites with no endogenous counterpart and no dietary requirement.
items.source: DOI 10.1155/2021/9989546, PMC8266448 (Li et al., Evid Based Complement Alternat Med 2021;2021:9989546, quality evaluation of randomised controlled trials of Rhodiola species, 39 RCTs across four species); PMID 21036578 (Hung, Perry & Ernst, Phytomedicine 2011;18:235-244, systematic review of 11 placebo-controlled trials of Rhodiola rosea)
corrections_applied: function_full/source: the 39-trial multi-species poor-reporting claim was attached to PMID 21036578, which is an 11-trial single-species review reaching a favourable quality verdict; the claim now cites its actual source, Li et al. 2021 (DOI 10.1155/2021/9989546)

function_full: corrected 'three Rhodiola species' to four (23 R. rosea, 8 R. crenulata, 8 R. wallichiana, 1 R. sacra, the last excluded from quality assessment) and replaced the vague quality wording with the review's finding that no study met all CONSORT criteria

function_full: Hung 2011 retained in the row but now reported as what it actually found (11 R. rosea trials, quality moderate or good, 5 of 10 above 3 on Jadad, limitation being lack of independent replication) instead of the opposite verdict previously attributed to it

items.function_short: A sedative root preparation; nothing in the body is built from it or needs it.
items.function_full: Valeriana officinalis root yields valerenic acid, valerenol and a variable mixture of valepotriates whose content differs widely between commercial products and degrades on storage. Valerenic acid binds a distinct site on GABA-A receptors that depends on the beta2 and beta3 subunits: the N265M point mutation in those subunits abolishes the drug response, and valerenic acid and valerenol are anxiolytic in mouse elevated plus-maze and light/dark tests. Human sleep trials are small, short and inconsistent, in part because extracts are not standardised to any single constituent. No human pathway synthesises or consumes these compounds, so there is no requirement for them.
items.source: PMID 18602406 (Benke et al., Neuropharmacology 2009;56:174-181, GABA-A receptors as in vivo substrate for the anxiolytic action of valerenic acid)

items.function_short: A leaf extract sold for memory; it is not a nutrient and nothing requires it.
items.function_full: Standardised extracts such as EGb 761 contain about 24% flavone glycosides and 6% terpene lactones, the latter comprising ginkgolides A, B and C plus bilobalide, with ginkgolide B acting as a platelet-activating factor antagonist. The largest prevention trial, the Ginkgo Evaluation of Memory study, randomised 3069 community volunteers aged 75 and over and followed them for a median 6.1 years, finding no reduction in all-cause dementia or Alzheimer disease. Ginkgolides and bilobalide are plant terpenoids absent from human metabolism, so no shortfall is possible from not taking them. The clinically relevant issue is the opposite direction: antiplatelet effect layered onto anticoagulants or aspirin.
items.source: PMID 19017911 (DeKosky et al., JAMA 2008;300:2253-2262, Ginkgo biloba for prevention of dementia, GEM trial)

items.function_short: A herb used for memory; the body makes no use of its active compounds.
items.function_full: Bacopa monnieri contains triterpenoid saponins known as bacosides, and extracts are standardised to bacoside content, typically 20 to 55%. A systematic review of randomised placebo-controlled trials, all of which ran for 12 weeks, found the most consistent signal in delayed word recall, with attention, working memory and other domains inconsistent across studies. Proposed mechanisms include cholinergic modulation, dendritic branching and antioxidant activity in hippocampus, drawn largely from rodent work. Bacosides are plant secondary metabolites: they are absent from human tissue, no enzyme system requires them, and gastrointestinal upset is the common practical limitation on dosing.
items.source: PMID 22747190 (Pase et al., J Altern Complement Med 2012;18:647-652, systematic review of randomised controlled Bacopa trials)

items.function_short: An edible mushroom studied for nerve growth effects; no bodily process depends on it.
items.function_full: Hericium erinaceus fruiting bodies contain hericenones and the mycelium contains erinacines, both of which stimulate nerve growth factor synthesis in cultured cells, with erinacine A shown to cross the blood-brain barrier in animals. The main human trial randomised 30 Japanese adults aged 50 to 80 with mild cognitive impairment to 3 g/day of dried powder or placebo for 16 weeks; cognitive scores improved on treatment and drifted back towards baseline during washout. As a culinary mushroom it contributes ordinary food nutrients such as beta-glucans, potassium and B vitamins, in the same way any mushroom does. The hericenones and erinacines themselves are not nutrients, are not made by human tissue, and no physiological process requires them.
items.source: PMID 18844328 (Mori et al., Phytother Res 2009;23:367-372, double-blind placebo-controlled trial in mild cognitive impairment)

items.function_short: A herbal antidepressant that also speeds up how the liver destroys many prescription drugs.
items.function_full: Hypericum perforatum extracts contain hypericin, pseudohypericin and hyperforin; hyperforin is the antidepressant-relevant constituent and inhibits reuptake of serotonin, noradrenaline and dopamine non-selectively. Hyperforin is also a potent ligand for the pregnane X receptor (Ki 27 nM), the nuclear receptor that drives transcription of CYP3A4 and P-glycoprotein, so the extract induces the clearance of a very wide range of co-administered drugs. Because CYP3A4 handles the oxidative metabolism of more than half of all medicines, this produces documented therapeutic failures with ciclosporin, tacrolimus, indinavir, warfarin and combined oral contraceptives, and serotonin toxicity when combined with SSRIs. Hypericin and hyperforin are plant products with no role in human physiology and no dietary requirement.
items.source: PMID 10852961 (Moore et al., Proc Natl Acad Sci USA 2000;97:7500-7502, St John's wort induces hepatic drug metabolism through activation of the pregnane X receptor)

items.function_short: The chemical step between tryptophan and serotonin; the body makes its own supply.
items.function_full: 5-hydroxytryptophan is the intermediate between the essential amino acid tryptophan and serotonin: tryptophan hydroxylase produces it, and aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase converts it onward to serotonin. Supplemental 5-HTP bypasses the rate-limiting hydroxylation step and escapes diversion into the kynurenine pathway, which is why it raises serotonin synthesis more directly than tryptophan does, including in peripheral tissues where that is not wanted. Ordinary food supplies essentially none of it; the dietary requirement is for tryptophan, and that is where any nutritional argument belongs. Impaired central serotonin synthesis in tetrahydrobiopterin disorders and in aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase deficiency is an inborn error of metabolism, entirely separate from intake, and 5-HTP is prescribed or withheld in those conditions on genetic grounds.
items.source: PMID 11869656 (Shaw, Turner & Del Mar, Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2002;(1):CD003198, tryptophan and 5-hydroxytryptophan for depression); PMID 10721089 (Klarskov K, Johnson KL, Benson LM, Gleich GJ, Naylor S, Adv Exp Med Biol 1999;467:461-468, eosinophilia-myalgia syndrome case-associated contaminants in commercially available 5-hydroxytryptophan)
corrections_applied: source: PMID 10721089 redated from 2000 to 1999 and given its full citation (Klarskov K, Johnson KL, Benson LM, Gleich GJ, Naylor S, Adv Exp Med Biol 1999;467:461-468)

items.supplement: Saffron, SAMe and other mood botanicals
items.function_short: Mood supplements of different chemistry; none is a nutrient the body must obtain.
items.function_full: Saffron supplies crocin, crocetin and safranal from Crocus sativus stigmas, and trials of about 30 mg/day over 6 to 8 weeks report antidepressant effects, though most are small, brief and concentrated in a narrow set of centres, which limits confidence. SAMe is chemically different in kind: the body synthesises it from methionine and ATP through methionine adenosyltransferase, and it serves as the universal methyl donor for DNA, phospholipid, catecholamine and creatine methylation. A Cochrane review of 8 trials and 934 participants found no clear difference between SAMe and imipramine or escitalopram used alone, and only low-quality evidence favouring SAMe added to an SSRI. Neither category is an essential nutrient: saffron constituents are plant secondary metabolites, and SAMe is made endogenously, with low tissue SAMe appearing only as a downstream consequence of folate or vitamin B12 deficiency or of the inborn error MAT1A deficiency.
items.source: PMID 25384672 (Lopresti & Drummond, Hum Psychopharmacol 2014;29:517-527, saffron for depression systematic review); DOI 10.1002/14651858.CD011286.pub2 (Galizia et al., Cochrane Database Syst Rev 2016, SAMe for depression in adults)

items.function_short: Live bacteria given in defined doses, where each named strain acts as its own drug.
items.function_full: The accepted definition is live micro-organisms which, when administered in adequate amounts, confer a health benefit on the host, and the operative unit of evidence is the strain, written as genus, species and an alphanumeric designator (for example Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG or Saccharomyces boulardii CNCM I-745). Strain-level genetics determine adhesion proteins, bacteriocin production, bile salt hydrolase activity and short-chain fatty acid output, so a trial result for one strain carries no information about a different strain of the same species. Most administered strains transit the gut without colonising, and the effect ceases when dosing stops. This is a therapeutic product class, not a nutrient class, so there is nothing a person can be short of.
items.source: DOI 10.1038/nrgastro.2014.66 (Hill et al., Nat Rev Gastroenterol Hepatol 2014;11:506-514, ISAPP consensus statement on the scope and appropriate use of the term probiotic)
corrections_applied: deficiency_state: NA changed to NONE, matching the row's own finding that there is nothing a person can be short of and resolving the contradiction with deficiency_name NONE

items.function_short: Mixed bacteria sold without strain identification, so no trial evidence attaches to the contents.
items.function_full: These products name only genus and species (Lactobacillus acidophilus, Bifidobacterium bifidum and similar) and omit the alphanumeric strain designation on which the entire clinical evidence base is built, so no published result can legitimately be attributed to what is in the capsule. Independent testing repeatedly finds discrepancies between labelled and actual colony-forming units, species misidentification, and organisms no longer viable at the end of shelf life. Adding more strains does not sum their individual effects; strains can antagonise one another through bacteriocins and niche competition, and mixtures are rarely tested as mixtures. Because this is a commercial product category rather than a nutrient, no requirement and no deficiency state exists.
items.source: DOI 10.1038/nrgastro.2014.66 (Hill et al., Nat Rev Gastroenterol Hepatol 2014;11:506-514, strain specificity requirement); DOI 10.1080/03007995.2017.1322571 (Curr Med Res Opin 2017, strain specificity, symptoms and mechanisms in IBS probiotics)
corrections_applied: deficiency_state: NA changed to NONE; a commercial product category with no requirement is an evaluated NONE, not an unevaluated question

items.function_short: A single gut bacterium with its own trial evidence in irritable bowel syndrome.
items.function_full: Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis 35624, still widely labelled Bifidobacterium infantis 35624, was isolated from healthy human gut mucosa and is one of the few probiotic strains tested at a defined dose in a trial large enough to matter. In 362 primary care women with irritable bowel syndrome of any bowel habit subtype, 1 x 10^8 cfu daily for 4 weeks was superior to placebo for abdominal pain and for a composite of bloating, bowel dysfunction, incomplete evacuation, straining and passage of gas, with global symptom improvement exceeding placebo by more than 20%; higher and lower doses did not work, which is itself informative about formulation. Proposed mechanisms include induction of regulatory T cells and reduction in circulating pro-inflammatory cytokines. It is a live organism administered as a therapy, so nobody is short of it and there is no deficiency state to describe.
items.source: PMID 16863564 (Whorwell et al., Am J Gastroenterol 2006;101:1581-1590, encapsulated Bifidobacterium infantis 35624 in women with IBS)
corrections_applied: deficiency_state: NA changed to NONE; a single named organism at a defined dose is as specific an entity as melatonin or berberine, and the row already stated that nobody is short of it while deficiency_name read NONE

items.function_short: Gut enzymes that split milk sugar and break down fat, protein and starch.
items.function_full: Lactase-phlorizin hydrolase sits in the small intestinal brush border and cleaves lactose into glucose and galactose; whatever escapes digestion reaches the colon, where bacteria ferment it into hydrogen, methane and short-chain fatty acids, producing the familiar symptoms. The exocrine pancreas secretes lipase and colipase, amylase, and the proteases trypsinogen and chymotrypsinogen, and lipase is the critical one because no other organ can substitute for it. The gland holds a large functional reserve: in the classic secretion studies, steatorrhoea did not appear until lipase output had fallen to 10% of normal or below, and creatorrhoea only below 10% of normal trypsin, which is why malabsorption in chronic pancreatitis declares itself late. The decline of intestinal lactase after weaning is the normal human developmental programme; retaining it into adulthood (lactase persistence) is the derived condition, driven chiefly by the LCT -13910C>T variant upstream of the lactase gene and selected for in dairying populations.
items.deficiency_name: Exocrine pancreatic insufficiency is the genuine clinical deficiency in this pairing. Congenital lactase deficiency is a separate, rare autosomal recessive disorder presenting in the newborn. Adult lactase non-persistence is NOT a deficiency disease: it is the ancestral and worldwide-majority human phenotype.
items.deficiency_early: Exocrine pancreatic insufficiency starts with bloating, flatulence, loose pale stools and unintended weight loss despite preserved appetite; a low faecal elastase-1 and falling fat-soluble vitamin levels (A, D, E, K) usually precede visible steatorrhoea by a long interval. Lactase non-persistence, being a physiological trait rather than a disease, shows only as dose-dependent bloating, cramps, audible bowel sounds and osmotic diarrhoea beginning 30 minutes to 2 hours after a lactose load, with most affected adults tolerating around 12 g of lactose (one glass of milk) without trouble.
items.deficiency_severe: Untreated exocrine pancreatic insufficiency causes overt steatorrhoea, progressive weight loss and sarcopenia, fat-soluble vitamin deficiency with osteopenia and osteoporosis, and in cystic fibrosis, failure to thrive in infancy; excess mortality in chronic pancreatitis is concentrated in those with untreated malabsorption. Lactase non-persistence has no severe clinical endpoint whatsoever. The only downstream risk is a calcium and vitamin D shortfall in people who eliminate dairy entirely without substituting an alternative source.
items.reversibility_note: Pancreatic enzyme replacement restores fat and protein absorption, reverses weight loss and corrects fat-soluble vitamin levels while it is being taken, but destroyed acinar tissue does not regenerate, so treatment is lifelong and bone density already lost recovers only in part. Lactase non-persistence is permanent because it is the normal genetic programme rather than a lesion; symptoms resolve completely with lactose restriction, fermented dairy or exogenous lactase, and the underlying trait is not something to correct.
items.at_risk: Exocrine pancreatic insufficiency: people with chronic pancreatitis (as many as 8 in 10 eventually), cystic fibrosis (the great majority, most within the first year of life), pancreatic cancer, and those after pancreatic resection or major gastric surgery. Lactase non-persistence: the global adult majority, with the highest frequencies in East and Southeast Asian, sub-Saharan African, Indigenous American and Middle Eastern populations, and the lowest in northern and northwestern Europeans and their descendants.
items.prevalence: Roughly two-thirds of the world's adult population is lactase non-persistent, which is the normal phenotype rather than a disease prevalence (PMID 32899182). Exocrine pancreatic insufficiency prevalence is condition-dependent: up to about 80% of adults with chronic pancreatitis and close to 9 in 10 infants with cystic fibrosis within the first year.
items.source: PMID 32899182 (Nutrients 2020;12:2689, genetics of lactose intolerance with interactive world maps of phenotype and genotype frequencies); PMID 11788828 (Enattah et al., Nat Genet 2002;30:233-237, LCT -13910C>T variant associated with adult-type hypolactasia); PMID 4693931, DOI 10.1056/NEJM197304192881603 (DiMagno, Go & Summerskill, N Engl J Med 1973;288:813-815, steatorrhoea below 10% of normal lipase output); StatPearls NBK555926 (exocrine pancreatic insufficiency)

items.function_short: Mixed plant and fungal enzymes sold for bloating; prescription pancreatic enzymes are a different product.
items.function_full: These blends typically combine fungal amylase and protease, cellulase, bromelain, papain and sometimes lipase, at doses and in formulations that are not designed to survive gastric acid or to be matched to a meal's fat content. Prescription pancrelipase is a different class of product: enteric-coated, dosed in thousands of lipase units per gram of dietary fat, and regulated in the US as a drug requiring an approved application since 2010. Two components have a defined use in people who need them, lactase for lactose intolerance and alpha-galactosidase for gas from raffinose-family oligosaccharides in legumes; the broad multi-enzyme blends have no established indication in anyone with a normal pancreas, since a healthy gland already secretes roughly ten times the lipase needed. This is a commercial product category rather than a nutrient, so no requirement and no deficiency state applies.
items.source: PMID 4693931, DOI 10.1056/NEJM197304192881603 (DiMagno et al., N Engl J Med 1973, pancreatic secretory reserve); StatPearls NBK555926 (exocrine pancreatic insufficiency and pancreatic enzyme replacement therapy); US FDA requirement that exocrine pancreatic insufficiency drug products hold approved NDAs, enforced from April 2010
corrections_applied: deficiency_state: NA changed to NONE, matching the row's own statement that no requirement and no deficiency state applies, and bringing it into line with the sister row 'Lactase and pancreatic enzymes' which correctly carries the real clinical deficiency

items.function_short: Giving live bacteria to intensive care patients; large trials show no benefit and real harm.
items.function_full: The rationale was that critical illness collapses gut microbial diversity and promotes translocation of pathogens across a compromised barrier, so restoring commensals might prevent ventilator-associated pneumonia and sepsis. PROSPECT randomised 2650 mechanically ventilated ICU patients across 44 units to Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG or placebo and found ventilator-associated pneumonia in 21.9% versus 21.3% (hazard ratio 1.03, 95% CI 0.87 to 1.22), with no benefit on any secondary outcome. PROPATRIA, in 298 patients with predicted severe acute pancreatitis, found mortality of 16% on a multispecies probiotic against 6% on placebo (relative risk 2.53, 95% CI 1.22 to 5.25), with nine cases of bowel ischaemia in the probiotic arm and none on placebo, eight of them fatal; that trial has carried an Expression of Concern from The Lancet since March 2010, issued after a Dutch investigation by the IGZ, CCMO and VWA into its design, approval and conduct, and it has not been retracted. Probiotic bacteraemia and Saccharomyces fungaemia are separately documented in patients with central venous catheters or a breached gut barrier, which is why this is a setting where a live organism behaves as a hazard rather than a supplement.
items.source: PMID 34546300 (Johnstone et al., JAMA 2021;326:1024-1033, PROSPECT trial); PMID 18279948 (Besselink et al., Lancet 2008;371:651-659, PROPATRIA trial, subject to a Lancet Expression of Concern from March 2010, not retracted)
corrections_applied: deficiency_state: NA changed to NONE; no deficiency state exists for live organisms given as therapy, the same finding coded NONE on comparable non-nutrient rows

function_full/source: added the March 2010 Lancet Expression of Concern on PROPATRIA and noted it is not a retraction, as the checker asked, so the mortality and bowel ischaemia figures are not read without it

items.function_short: Pills sold for erections; a large share of the products FDA has flagged contain undeclared PDE5 inhibitors.
items.function_full: Marketed as herbal or all-natural, these products routinely contain undeclared PDE5 inhibitors. Of 776 dietary supplements associated with US FDA warnings between 2007 and 2016, 353 (45.5%) were sexual enhancement products, and within that group sildenafil was identified in 47.0%, sildenafil analogues in 38.0%, tadalafil in 20.4% and the antidepressant dapoxetine in 4.0%. The botanicals actually named on the label (Panax ginseng, Tribulus terrestris, Epimedium, yohimbe, maca) have no established effect on erectile function at the quantities supplied, so any felt effect points to the hidden pharmaceutical. The concrete danger is a vasodilator taken unknowingly alongside nitrates or in the presence of cardiac disease, since the user believes the product is herbal and does not mention it to a clinician. As a product category there is no nutrient here and no deficiency state.
items.source: PMID 30646238, DOI 10.1001/jamanetworkopen.2018.3337 (Tucker et al., JAMA Netw Open 2018;1:e183337, unapproved pharmaceutical ingredients in dietary supplements associated with FDA warnings)
corrections_applied: function_short: restored the denominator the short line had dropped, now reading 'a large share of the products FDA has flagged contain undeclared PDE5 inhibitors' so it no longer implies the whole sexual-enhancement market
deficiency_state: NA changed to NONE, matching the row's own statement that there is no nutrient here and no deficiency state

items.function_short: Stimulant and herbal blends for fat loss; adulteration with withdrawn drugs is common.
items.function_full: Typical declared ingredients are caffeine, green tea catechins, synephrine, yohimbine, garcinia and undisclosed stimulant analogues, often behind a proprietary blend label that conceals individual doses. Weight-loss products accounted for 317 of the 776 supplements associated with US FDA warnings from 2007 to 2016, and within them 84.9% contained sibutramine, an appetite suppressant suspended in the EU in January 2010 and withdrawn in the US in October 2010 over cardiovascular events, though it remained on the market in some countries afterwards; 23.7% contained the laxative phenolphthalein, 6.3% contained sibutramine analogues and 5.4% contained fluoxetine. Non-bodybuilding herbal and dietary supplements as a class carry the worst liver outcomes in the US Drug-Induced Liver Injury Network: among DILIN-enrolled liver-injury cases, death or liver transplantation occurred in 13% of the 85 non-bodybuilding supplement cases against 3% for conventional medications. That group is heterogeneous, covering weight-loss along with energy, joint, immune and mixed products, and the figure describes outcomes among adjudicated cases already in a hepatology referral network rather than the risk of taking such a product. This is a commercial product category built on stimulants and adulterants; there is no nutrient in it and nothing a person can be deficient in.
items.source: PMID 30646238 (Tucker et al., JAMA Netw Open 2018;1:e183337); PMID 25043597 (Navarro et al., Hepatology 2014;60:1399-1408, liver injury from herbals and dietary supplements in the US DILIN, 130 HDS cases among 839 enrollees, 45 bodybuilding and 85 non-bodybuilding)
corrections_applied: function_full: the 13% death-or-transplant figure re-scoped from weight-loss and fat-burner blends to non-bodybuilding herbal and dietary supplements as a class, qualified as an outcome among DILIN-enrolled liver-injury cases rather than a risk of taking the products, and the heterogeneity of that 85-case group stated
function_full: 'sibutramine, withdrawn worldwide in 2010' replaced with the actual timeline, EU suspension January 2010 and US withdrawal October 2010, with continued marketing in some countries
deficiency_state: NA changed to NONE, matching the row's own statement that there is nothing a person can be deficient in
source: Navarro citation annotated with the case counts that anchor the corrected figure

items.function_short: Muscle and testosterone products; nearly nine in ten flagged ones contain hidden synthetic steroids.
items.function_full: These products promise anabolic effect from Tribulus terrestris, D-aspartic acid, fenugreek, boron and similar botanicals, none of which raises serum testosterone in men with normal gonadal function at the doses supplied. Of 92 muscle-building supplements associated with US FDA warnings between 2007 and 2016, 89.1% contained synthetic steroids or steroid-like compounds that were not declared on the label. In the US Drug-Induced Liver Injury Network, 45 of 130 supplement-related liver injuries came from bodybuilding products, causing prolonged cholestatic jaundice in young men that lasted weeks to months, though without deaths or transplants in that series. Liver injury attributed to herbal and dietary supplements rose from 7% to 20% of all DILIN cases between 2004 and 2013, and this category is a substantial part of that rise. It is a product class with no nutritional content, so no deficiency state exists.
items.source: PMID 30646238 (Tucker et al., JAMA Netw Open 2018;1:e183337); PMID 25043597 (Navarro et al., Hepatology 2014;60:1399-1408, DILIN herbal and dietary supplement hepatotoxicity)
corrections_applied: deficiency_state: NA changed to NONE, matching the row's own statement that no deficiency state exists for a product class with no nutritional content

items.function_short_zh: 松果体在天黑后分泌的一种激素,用来告知生物钟夜晚已经开始。
items.function_full_zh: 褪黑素由松果体以血清素为原料合成,合成节律受视交叉上核控制,通常在习惯入睡时间前约两小时开始上升,清晨降至基线。它通过生物钟本身的MT1和MT2受体发挥作用,是一种定时信号而非镇静剂,这正是傍晚小剂量比大剂量更能可靠地移动睡眠时相、却不能像大剂量那样加深睡眠的原因。人体完全不存在对它的膳食需求:所用的每一个分子都由自身合成。夜间峰值浓度会随年龄下降(研究人群平均年龄65至70岁时汇总峰值约为49 pg/mL,75岁及以上人群约为28 pg/mL),而200 lux以下的普通傍晚室内光照会使99%的人褪黑素起始时间推迟,并将夜间褪黑素窗口缩短约90分钟。因此常见的问题是信号时相错位或信号减弱,并非营养素缺乏。

items.function_short_zh: 一种降低血糖和胆固醇的植物生物碱,人体并不需要它。
items.function_full_zh: 小檗碱是从小檗属(Berberis)、黄连属(Coptis)和金印草属(Hydrastis)植物中提取的异喹啉类生物碱。其代谢作用通常归因于AMP活化蛋白激酶(AMPK)的激活,而上游触发机制似乎是对线粒体复合体I的轻度抑制,从而升高细胞内AMP与ATP的比值(Turner等,Diabetes 2008;57:1414-1418),这使其在机制上与二甲双胍有某种家族相似性。但AMPK并非全部机制:Xu等人证实了复合体I的这一效应,但得出的结论是小檗碱促进葡萄糖消耗的作用独立于AMPK激活。在下游,它抑制肝脏糖异生,并通过ERK依赖性的LDL受体mRNA稳定作用上调肝脏LDL受体表达,这一途径与AMPK无关(Kong等,Nat Med 2004;10:1344-1351)。口服吸收很差,在大鼠中绝对生物利用度低于1%,因此其作用很可能有相当一部分是在肠腔内及对肠道菌群发挥的。它是一种外源性化合物:人体组织不合成它,任何生理过程也不依赖它的存在。

items.function_short_zh: 一种用于缓解压力的根部提取物,在正常人体生理中不起任何作用。
items.function_full_zh: 睡茄(Withania somnifera)根含有睡茄内酯类成分(主要是withaferin A和withanolide A),并伴有sitoindosides,商业提取物通常按睡茄内酯含量进行标准化。为期8至12周的随机试验报告显示,自评压力量表评分和晨间血清皮质醇有轻度下降,而所提出的下丘脑垂体肾上腺轴及GABA-A受体机制主要依据动物和体外实验。人体没有任何组织合成睡茄内酯,也没有代谢通路需要它,因此这属于药理学暴露,而非营养摄入。肝损伤是已被记录的一种危害:冰岛与美国药物性肝损伤网络(DILIN)的一份病例系列报道了5例患者(男性3例,女性2例,平均年龄43岁,范围21至62岁),在开始服用南非醉茄后2至12周出现黄疸,呈胆汁淤积性或混合性损伤(R值1.4至3.3),高胆红素血症持续5至20周。5例中有4例的肝功能在1至5个月内恢复正常,第5例失访。该系列中无一例发展为肝功能衰竭,也无死亡或肝移植病例。

items.function_short_zh: 一种用于缓解疲劳的北极根部提取物,人体既不合成也不需要它。
items.function_full_zh: 红景天(Rhodiola rosea)根茎提供玫瑰苷类成分(rosavin、rosin、rosarin)及红景天苷(salidroside),研究最充分的制剂SHR-5标准化含量约为3%玫瑰苷和1%红景天苷。提出的作用机制包括较弱的单胺氧化酶抑制以及减弱应激诱导的皮质醇反应,但两者在人体中都未得到充分表征。一项2021年的系统评价纳入了39项随机试验,涵盖四个红景天属物种(23项为红景天Rhodiola rosea,8项为Rhodiola crenulata,8项为Rhodiola wallichiana,1项为Rhodiola sacra,后者未纳入质量评估),发现没有一项研究完全符合CONSORT标准,说明报告质量差到不足以支持确凿的疗效结论,而且不同物种的试验经常被混为一谈。另一篇早期综述仅纳入11项红景天(单一物种)的安慰剂对照试验,评定其方法学质量为中等或良好(10项中有5项Jadad评分高于3分),结论认为该物种可能对体能表现、脑力表现及某些精神健康状况有益,其自述的局限性是缺乏独立重复验证。这些都是植物次生代谢物,人体内没有内源性对应物,也不存在膳食需求。

items.function_short_zh: 一种镇静用根部制剂,人体内没有任何东西由它构成,也不需要它。
items.function_full_zh: 缬草(Valeriana officinalis)根产生缬草酸(valerenic acid)、缬草醇(valerenol),以及组成比例不定的缬草烯酸酯(valepotriates)混合物,不同商业产品间含量差异很大,且储存过程中会降解。缬草酸结合于GABA-A受体上一个依赖beta2和beta3亚基的特定位点:这些亚基上的N265M点突变会消除该药物反应,而缬草酸和缬草醇在小鼠高架十字迷宫和明暗箱试验中均表现出抗焦虑作用。人体睡眠试验规模小、时程短且结果不一致,部分原因是提取物并未按任何单一成分进行标准化。人体没有代谢通路合成或消耗这些化合物,因此对它们不存在需求。

items.function_short_zh: 一种用于改善记忆的叶片提取物,它不是营养素,人体也不需要它。
items.function_full_zh: 标准化提取物如EGb 761含约24%黄酮苷及6%萜内酯,后者包括银杏内酯A、B、C(ginkgolides A、B、C)和白果内酯(bilobalide),其中银杏内酯B是血小板活化因子的拮抗剂。规模最大的预防性试验,即银杏记忆评估研究,纳入3069名75岁及以上的社区志愿者,中位随访6.1年,结果显示对全因痴呆或阿尔茨海默病(Alzheimer disease)没有降低作用。银杏内酯和白果内酯是植物萜类化合物,人体代谢中不存在,因此不摄入它们不会造成任何短缺。真正具有临床意义的问题方向恰恰相反:抗血小板作用叠加在抗凝药或阿司匹林之上。

items.function_short_zh: 一种用于改善记忆的草药,人体不会利用其活性成分。
items.function_full_zh: 假马齿苋(Bacopa monnieri)含有称为bacosides的三萜皂苷类成分,提取物通常按bacoside含量标准化,一般为20%至55%。一项针对随机安慰剂对照试验的系统评价发现,所有纳入试验疗程均为12周,其中最一致的信号出现在延迟词语回忆上,而注意力、工作记忆等其他认知领域在各研究间结果并不一致。所提出的机制包括胆碱能调节、海马树突分支增加及抗氧化作用,这些主要来自啮齿动物研究。bacosides是植物次生代谢物:人体组织中不存在它们,也没有酶系统需要它们,胃肠道不适是限制其实际用量的常见因素。

items.function_short_zh: 一种因促进神经生长作用而被研究的食用菌,人体没有任何过程依赖它。
items.function_full_zh: 猴头菇(Hericium erinaceus)子实体含有hericenones,菌丝体含有erinacines,两者在培养细胞中均能刺激神经生长因子合成,其中erinacine A已在动物实验中证实可穿过血脑屏障。主要的人体试验将30名50至80岁、患轻度认知障碍的日本成年人随机分组,每日服用3 g干燥粉末或安慰剂,持续16周,结果显示治疗组认知评分改善,而在洗脱期又逐渐回到基线水平。作为一种食用菌,它像任何蘑菇一样提供普通的食物营养素,如β-葡聚糖、钾和B族维生素。hericenones和erinacines本身并非营养素,人体组织不会合成它们,也没有生理过程需要它们。

items.function_short_zh: 一种草药抗抑郁剂,同时会加快肝脏清除许多处方药的速度。
items.function_full_zh: 贯叶连翘(Hypericum perforatum)提取物含有金丝桃素(hypericin)、伪金丝桃素(pseudohypericin)和贯叶金丝桃素(hyperforin),其中hyperforin是与抗抑郁作用相关的成分,能非选择性地抑制血清素、去甲肾上腺素和多巴胺的再摄取。hyperforin同时也是孕烷X受体的强效配体(Ki为27 nM),该核受体驱动CYP3A4和P-糖蛋白(P-glycoprotein)的转录,因此这种提取物会诱导广泛一类合并用药的清除。由于CYP3A4负责一半以上药物的氧化代谢,这会导致与环孢素(ciclosporin)、他克莫司(tacrolimus)、茚地那韦(indinavir)、华法林(warfarin)及复方口服避孕药合用时出现有据可查的治疗失败,并在与SSRI类药物合用时引发5-羟色胺毒性。金丝桃素和贯叶金丝桃素是植物产物,在人体生理中没有作用,也不存在膳食需求。

items.function_short_zh: 色氨酸转化为血清素过程中的中间产物,人体自身即可合成所需的量。
items.function_full_zh: 5-羟色氨酸(5-HTP)是必需氨基酸色氨酸(tryptophan)与血清素之间的中间产物:由色氨酸羟化酶(tryptophan hydroxylase)生成,再由芳香族L-氨基酸脱羧酶(aromatic L-amino acid decarboxylase)进一步转化为血清素。补充的5-HTP绕过了限速的羟化步骤,并避开了向犬尿氨酸通路的分流,这就是它比色氨酸更直接地提高血清素合成的原因,包括在不希望发生此事的外周组织中。普通食物基本不提供5-HTP,膳食需求针对的是色氨酸,任何营养学论证都应落在色氨酸上。四氢生物蝶呤(tetrahydrobiopterin)代谢障碍及芳香族L-氨基酸脱羧酶缺乏症中出现的中枢血清素合成受损,是一种先天性代谢缺陷,与摄入量完全无关,在这些情况下是否使用5-HTP是基于遗传学理由决定的。

items.supplement: Saffron, SAMe and other mood botanicals
items.supplement_zh: 藏红花、SAMe及其他情绪类草本制剂
items.function_short_zh: 化学性质各不相同的情绪类补充剂,均非人体必须获取的营养素。
items.function_full_zh: 藏红花(Crocus sativus)柱头提供藏红花素(crocin)、藏红花酸(crocetin)和藏红花醛(safranal),每日约30 mg、持续6至8周的试验报告显示有抗抑郁效果,但多数研究规模小、时程短且集中在少数几个中心,这限制了结果的可信度。SAMe在化学性质上完全不同:人体通过甲硫氨酸腺苷转移酶(methionine adenosyltransferase)由甲硫氨酸和ATP合成SAMe,它是DNA、磷脂、儿茶酚胺和肌酸甲基化反应的通用甲基供体。一项纳入8项试验、934名受试者的Cochrane系统评价发现,单独使用时SAMe与丙咪嗪(imipramine)或艾司西酞普兰(escitalopram)之间没有明显差异,而SAMe加用于SSRI类药物的证据质量较低,仅有限地支持其有效。这两类都不是必需营养素:藏红花成分是植物次生代谢物,而SAMe由人体内源合成,组织内SAMe水平偏低只是叶酸或维生素B12缺乏、或先天性代谢缺陷MAT1A基因缺乏的下游后果。

items.function_short_zh: 以确定剂量给予的活菌,每一个具名菌株都相当于其自身的一种药物。
items.function_full_zh: 公认的定义是:以足够数量给予时能为宿主带来健康益处的活微生物,而证据的实际单位是菌株,写法为属名、种名加字母数字编号(例如鼠李糖乳酪杆菌Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG,或布拉迪酵母菌Saccharomyces boulardii CNCM I-745)。菌株层面的遗传差异决定了黏附蛋白、细菌素(bacteriocin)产生、胆盐水解酶(bile salt hydrolase)活性和短链脂肪酸产量,因此某一菌株的试验结果对同一菌种的另一菌株没有任何提示意义。大多数给药菌株只是经过肠道而不定植,给药停止后作用也随之消失。这是一个治疗性产品类别,而不是营养素类别,因此不存在人可能短缺的东西。

items.supplement_zh: 通用多菌株益生菌复合制剂
items.function_short_zh: 未标明菌株的混合菌种产品,因此没有任何试验证据能对应到其内容物。
items.function_full_zh: 这类产品只标注属名和种名(如嗜酸乳杆菌Lactobacillus acidophilus、两歧双歧杆菌Bifidobacterium bifidum等),省略了整个临床证据基础所依赖的字母数字菌株编号,因此已发表的任何结果都不能合理归因于胶囊中的实际内容物。独立检测反复发现标签菌落形成单位(CFU)与实际含量不符、菌种鉴定错误,以及在保质期结束时已不再存活的菌体。增加菌株种类并不等于各菌株效果的叠加,菌株之间可通过细菌素和生态位竞争相互拮抗,而混合制剂很少作为整体进行测试。由于这是一个商业产品类别而非营养素,因此不存在需求,也不存在缺乏状态。

items.supplement_zh: 婴儿双歧杆菌35624(单一菌株)
items.function_short_zh: 一种拥有自身肠易激综合征试验证据的单一肠道菌株。
items.function_full_zh: 长双歧杆菌婴儿亚种35624(Bifidobacterium longum subsp. infantis 35624),目前仍广泛标注为Bifidobacterium infantis 35624,分离自健康人体肠道黏膜,是少数在足够规模的试验中以确定剂量测试过的益生菌菌株之一。在362名任意肠道习惯亚型的肠易激综合征初级保健女性患者中,每日1×10^8 cfu、持续4周,在腹痛以及由腹胀、排便功能障碍、排便不尽感、用力排便和排气组成的综合评分方面均优于安慰剂,总体症状改善超出安慰剂组20%以上;更高或更低剂量均无效,这一点本身也提示了配方的重要性。所提出的机制包括诱导调节性T细胞及降低循环促炎细胞因子水平。它是作为一种疗法给予的活微生物,因此没有人会短缺它,也不存在需要描述的缺乏状态。

items.function_short_zh: 分解乳糖以及分解脂肪、蛋白质和淀粉的肠道与胰腺酶。
items.function_full_zh: 乳糖酶-根皮苷水解酶(lactase-phlorizin hydrolase)位于小肠刷状缘,将乳糖分解为葡萄糖和半乳糖;未被消化的部分进入结肠,由细菌发酵产生氢气、甲烷和短链脂肪酸,从而引起常见症状。胰腺外分泌部分泌脂肪酶(lipase)和辅脂酶(colipase)、淀粉酶(amylase),以及蛋白酶胰蛋白酶原(trypsinogen)和糜蛋白酶原(chymotrypsinogen),其中脂肪酶是关键所在,因为没有其他器官能替代它的功能。胰腺具有很大的功能储备:在经典的分泌研究中,脂肪酶输出降至正常值的10%或以下时才出现脂肪泻(steatorrhoea),胰蛋白酶降至正常值10%以下时才出现肌酸泻(creatorrhoea),这正是慢性胰腺炎中的吸收不良往往迟迟才表现出来的原因。断奶后肠道乳糖酶活性下降是人类正常的发育程序;成年后仍保留乳糖酶活性(乳糖酶持续性)才是衍生出的状态,主要由乳糖酶基因(LCT)上游的-13910C>T变异驱动,并在从事乳制品生产的人群中受到选择。
items.deficiency_name_zh: 胰腺外分泌功能不全(exocrine pancreatic insufficiency)是这一配对中真正的临床缺乏状态。先天性乳糖酶缺乏症是另一种独立、罕见的常染色体隐性遗传病,在新生儿期发病。成年乳糖酶非持续性(lactase non-persistence)不是一种缺乏性疾病:它是人类祖先型且在全球占多数的表型。
items.deficiency_early_zh: 胰腺外分泌功能不全起初表现为腹胀、排气增多、大便稀软色浅,以及食欲未减却体重意外下降;粪便elastase-1水平降低及脂溶性维生素(A、D、E、K)水平下降通常比肉眼可见的脂肪泻(steatorrhoea)早出现很长一段时间。乳糖酶非持续性是一种生理特征而非疾病,表现仅为剂量依赖性的腹胀、痉挛、可闻及的肠鸣音,以及摄入乳糖后30分钟至2小时内出现的渗透性腹泻,大多数受影响的成年人可耐受约12 g乳糖(相当于一杯牛奶)而不出现症状。
items.deficiency_severe_zh: 未经治疗的胰腺外分泌功能不全会导致明显的脂肪泻(steatorrhoea)、进行性体重下降和肌少症(sarcopenia)、脂溶性维生素缺乏并伴骨量减少和骨质疏松,在囊性纤维化(cystic fibrosis)患儿则表现为婴儿期生长发育迟滞;慢性胰腺炎的超额死亡率主要集中在未经治疗、存在吸收不良的患者中。乳糖酶非持续性完全没有任何严重的临床终点。唯一的下游风险是,完全停用乳制品而未以其他来源替代的人可能出现钙和维生素D不足。
items.reversibility_note_zh: 胰酶替代治疗在持续用药期间可恢复脂肪和蛋白质的吸收、逆转体重下降并纠正脂溶性维生素水平,但已被破坏的腺泡组织不会再生,因此治疗需终身进行,已经丢失的骨密度也只能部分恢复。乳糖酶非持续性是永久性的,因为它是正常的基因程序而非病变;通过限制乳糖摄入、改用发酵乳制品或外源补充乳糖酶,症状可以完全消除,而这一潜在特征本身并不是需要纠正的对象。
items.at_risk_zh: 胰腺外分泌功能不全的高危人群:慢性胰腺炎患者(最终10人中多达8人会出现)、囊性纤维化(cystic fibrosis)患者(绝大多数,多数在出生后第一年内出现)、胰腺癌患者,以及胰腺切除术或大型胃部手术后的患者。乳糖酶非持续性的高发人群:全球成年人中的多数,东亚和东南亚、撒哈拉以南非洲、美洲原住民及中东人群中的发生率最高,北欧和西北欧人群及其后裔中的发生率最低。
items.prevalence_zh: 全球约三分之二的成年人口为乳糖酶非持续性,这是正常表型的比例,而非一种疾病患病率(PMID 32899182)。胰腺外分泌功能不全的患病率因基础疾病而异:慢性胰腺炎成年患者中高达约80%,囊性纤维化(cystic fibrosis)患儿在出生后第一年内接近10人中9人。

items.supplement_zh: 非处方消化酶复合制剂
items.function_short_zh: 用于缓解腹胀的混合植物与真菌来源酶,处方级胰酶是不同的产品。
items.function_full_zh: 这类复合制剂通常混合真菌来源的淀粉酶(amylase)和蛋白酶(protease)、纤维素酶(cellulase)、菠萝蛋白酶(bromelain)、木瓜蛋白酶(papain),有时还含脂肪酶(lipase),其剂量和剂型并非为耐受胃酸或与某一餐脂肪含量相匹配而设计。处方级胰脂酶制剂(pancrelipase)属于不同类别的产品:采用肠溶包衣,按每克膳食脂肪所需的千单位脂肪酶计量,自2010年起在美国被作为需持有批准申请的药品监管。有两种成分在确有需要的人群中有明确用途,即用于乳糖不耐受的乳糖酶(lactase),以及用于缓解豆类中棉子糖家族低聚糖所致胀气的α-半乳糖苷酶(alpha-galactosidase);而广谱多酶复合制剂在胰腺功能正常者中没有确立的适应证,因为健康的胰腺本身分泌的脂肪酶量已是所需量的约十倍。这是一个商业产品类别而非营养素,因此不存在需求,也不适用缺乏状态。

items.supplement_zh: 危重症患者使用的益生菌
items.function_short_zh: 给重症监护患者使用活菌,大型试验显示无获益,反而存在真实危害。
items.function_full_zh: 这一思路的出发点是:危重疾病会使肠道菌群多样性崩溃,并促进病原体穿过受损屏障发生易位,因此恢复共生菌群或许能预防呼吸机相关性肺炎和脓毒症。PROSPECT试验将44个ICU中的2650名机械通气患者随机分组,给予鼠李糖乳酪杆菌GG(Lacticaseibacillus rhamnosus GG)或安慰剂,结果呼吸机相关性肺炎发生率分别为21.9%和21.3%(风险比1.03,95% CI 0.87至1.22),在任何次要结局上均无获益。PROPATRIA试验在298名预计重症急性胰腺炎患者中进行,结果多菌种益生菌组死亡率为16%,安慰剂组为6%(相对风险2.53,95% CI 1.22至5.25),益生菌组出现9例肠缺血,安慰剂组无一例,其中8例死亡;该试验自2010年3月起被《柳叶刀》(The Lancet)发出“关注声明”(Expression of Concern),这是荷兰的IGZ、CCMO和VWA三家机构对其设计、审批和实施展开调查后作出的,论文本身并未被撤稿。带有中心静脉导管或肠道屏障破损的患者中,已另有文献分别记录了益生菌菌血症和酵母菌(Saccharomyces)真菌血症的病例,这正是为什么在这种环境下活微生物表现为一种危害而非一种补充剂。

items.function_short_zh: 用于治疗勃起功能的药丸,FDA所标记产品中有相当一部分含有未标明的PDE5抑制剂。
items.function_full_zh: 这类产品以草本或纯天然为卖点,但经常含有未标明的PDE5抑制剂。在2007年至2016年间美国FDA警告所涉及的776种膳食补充剂中,353种(45.5%)为性功能增强类产品,在这一组产品中,西地那非(sildenafil)检出率为47.0%,西地那非类似物为38.0%,他达拉非(tadalafil)为20.4%,抗抑郁药达泊西汀(dapoxetine)为4.0%。标签上实际标注的植物成分(人参Panax ginseng、蒺藜Tribulus terrestris、淫羊藿Epimedium、育亨宾yohimbe、玛咖maca)在所提供的剂量下并无已确立的勃起功能改善作用,因此任何自觉的效果都指向隐藏的药物成分。真正具体的危险在于,使用者在不知情的情况下将一种血管扩张剂与硝酸酯类药物合用,或本身患有心脏病,却因为认为产品是“草本”而不会向临床医生提及。作为一个产品类别,这里面没有营养素,也不存在缺乏状态。

items.supplement_zh: 减肥、燃脂及能量补充复合制剂
items.function_short_zh: 用于减脂的兴奋剂与草本复合制剂,常被掺入已撤市药物。
items.function_full_zh: 常见标示成分包括咖啡因、绿茶儿茶素、辛弗林(synephrine)、育亨宾(yohimbine)、藤黄果(garcinia)以及未标明的兴奋剂类似物,通常隐藏在“专有配方”标签之下,掩盖了各成分的具体剂量。在2007年至2016年间美国FDA警告所涉及的776种补充剂中,减肥类产品占317种,其中84.9%含有西布曲明(sibutramine),这是一种食欲抑制剂,于2010年1月在欧盟暂停销售,2010年10月因心血管事件在美国撤市,但此后在部分国家仍继续在市场上销售;23.7%含有泻药酚酞(phenolphthalein),6.3%含有西布曲明类似物,5.4%含有氟西汀(fluoxetine)。在美国药物性肝损伤网络(DILIN)中,非健美类草本及膳食补充剂作为一类的肝脏结局最差:在DILIN登记的肝损伤病例中,85例非健美类补充剂病例中有13%发生死亡或肝移植,而常规药物这一比例为3%。该类别本身构成异质,涵盖减肥、能量、关节、免疫及混合类产品,该数字描述的是已经进入肝病转诊网络、被判定为病例的患者结局,而不是服用此类产品的风险本身。这是一个建立在兴奋剂和掺假物之上的商业产品类别;其中没有营养素,也没有人能在其中出现短缺。

items.supplement_zh: 健美与睾酮促进类产品
items.function_short_zh: 增肌与促睾产品,被标记的产品中近九成含有隐藏的合成类固醇。
items.function_full_zh: 这类产品声称蒺藜(Tribulus terrestris)、D-天门冬氨酸(D-aspartic acid)、葫芦巴(fenugreek)、硼及类似植物成分具有合成代谢效果,但在所提供的剂量下,这些成分均不会提高性腺功能正常男性的血清睾酮水平。在2007年至2016年间美国FDA警告所涉及的92种增肌类补充剂中,89.1%含有标签未标明的合成类固醇或类固醇样化合物。在美国药物性肝损伤网络(DILIN)中,130例补充剂相关肝损伤病例中有45例来自健美类产品,在年轻男性中引起持续数周至数月的胆汁淤积性黄疸,但该系列中未出现死亡或肝移植病例。2004年至2013年间,归因于草本及膳食补充剂的肝损伤在全部DILIN病例中的占比从7%升至20%,这一类别是这一升幅的重要组成部分。这是一个不含任何营养成分的产品类别,因此不存在缺乏状态。
